transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Well, I'm here because I just cannot seem to keep my work in order anymore. I work at a dry cleaner, and lately... the tickets, the receipts, workshop notes, and the customer jobs, they're just all piled together. It gets to the point where I look at it and I really just do not know what to handle first.
Were you having this same kind of difficulty keeping things organized before these recent work problems started?

Yes, honestly, it's been an issue for as long as I can remember. Even back when I was in grade school, my teachers used to tell my mother that I was bright but just... scattered. I was always the kid talking out of turn, losing my papers, and they constantly had to remind me to actually finish the work I started. So, yeah, this isn't exactly a new thing for me, it's just really getting in the way at work now.
When you were a child, were you often fidgety or unable to stay still?

I don't really remember being like that, no. I mean, I was definitely talkative and always losing things, like I said, but... I don't think I had trouble staying in my seat or anything. I wasn't really a fidgety kid as far as I can recall.
Before age 12, did you often have trouble paying close attention to schoolwork or making careless mistakes?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I lost my papers a lot, but when I actually sat down to do the work, I don't remember having a hard time focusing on it or making a bunch of careless mistakes. It was more just keeping track of everything that was the problem.
